'''Enchant Crossbow Bolt (Opal)''' is a [[Enchant Crossbow Bolt|bolt enchantment spell]] that requires a [[Magic]] level of 4 to cast. They are the first [[bolts]] you can enchant. It imbues 10 [[opal bolts]] each cast and turns them into [[opal bolts (e)]] or 10 [[opal dragon bolts]] into 10 [[opal dragon bolts (e)]]. The enchantment gives the effect ''Lucky Lightning''. Each bolt has a small chance to cause lightning to strike your opponent, causing extra damage based on your [[Ranged]] level.
